scripts.build:control: bun build packages/beacon/src/control-browser.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile apps/web/public/control.js
scripts.build:report: bun build apps/edge/src/report-browser.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile apps/web/public/reportgen.js
scripts.build:zgame: bun build packages/beacon/src/zgame-browser.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile apps/web/public/zgame.js
scripts.pages:deploy: bun run pages/build.mjs && cd pages && bunx wrangler@3 pages deploy public --project-name corporate-tic-tac-toe --branch main --commit-dirty=true
